{{Top|leg}}
'''Gacerian''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by the [[Gacerite]]s, a [[Species/Legends|species]] of bipedal [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] who hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gacerian]]. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] could speak Gacerian.

==Known words==
*''Dinn'' - "One who is always getting married and divorced."
